Endpoint values prove exactly one minimizer and the sharp a* threshold; extremal functions realize the contacts. At threshold, Φ_s and Φ_a are strictly positive, producing matching first derivatives and distinct second derivatives. The even local series follows by implicit differentiation. A standalone checker passes grid and numerical identities; it is not relied on to prove the continuum result.
